about: Dark Mystery is a Puzzled Platformer Game in which player faces different types of difficulties to find his true love. This Game is based on true love between Furry (Player) and her Queen which has been lost into the Dark World. This Game is fun making, full of challenging, brainstorming with 35 exciting levels.
• Amazing Brainstorming Puzzles in the Game.
• 2 Player Multiplayer Support on Single Screen.
• Player’s excitement increases as difficulty increases after every Level.
Get Ready for Adventurous Journey ahead…..
Enhanced game play on PS4 Pro console
One-time licence fee to download to multiple PS4 systems. Sign in to PlayStation is not required to use this on your primary PS4, but is required for use on other PS4 systems.
